overlayEntry.notes: apyUSD is the ERC-4626 yield wrapper over apxUSD; its ultimate credit exposure is the same Apyx reserve (STRC/SATA variable-rate perpetual preferred equity plus liquidity buffers) measured in the apxusd-apyx entry, so this review measures the wrapper itself and mirrors the underlying dispositions only where they hold for apyUSD specifically. On-chain reads at finalized Ethereum block 25627196 (hash 0x4662fa18d4450995897936a723ea054d4ab8b230e457cfb0b3aed424dfdccaf2, 2026-07-27T22:40:23Z) on wrapper 0x38eeb52f0771140d10c4e9a9a72349a329fe8a6a: asset() returned apxUSD 0x98A878b1Cd98131B271883B390f68D2c90674665; totalSupply 127,985,470.504192 shares; totalAssets 179,498,093.804223 apxUSD; convertToAssets(1e18) = 1.40248806 apxUSD per share, matching totalAssets/totalSupply to 3.4e-8 apxUSD; paused() false. The Accountable dashboard (fetched 2026-07-27T22:49Z, dashboard ts 1785192541861) is apxUSD-scoped: total supply 327,073,514.82 against total reserves $308,600,110.70 (collateralization 0.922477, redemption value 0.9155), split STRC $189.09M / POL $48.81M / Inventory $39.97M / Cash & Equivalents $30.73M; it publishes no apyUSD-specific breakdown and no maturity data. weightedAverageMaturityDays is unavailable: the wrapper holds apxUSD, and Apyx publishes no WAM/remaining-tenor dataset for the underlying reserve anywhere on the transparency surface; the principal disclosed STRC/SATA holdings are perpetual. valuationCadenceDays = 30 from the monthly Wolf & Company attestation archive (March-June 2026 reports pinned), mirroring the apxusd-apyx measurement of the same reserve; the wrapper exchange rate itself updates continuously on-chain via LinearVestV0 streaming but that is wrapper math over apxUSD, not an independent reserve valuation. Component adjudication under the D3 standard: creditQuality weak because the primary STRC/SATA documentation evidences the deficiency itself (crypto-linked perpetual preferred equity as the principal collateral). seniority limited: the documented ERC-4626 pro-rata vault claim is corroborated by the pinned on-chain read (wrapper backing ratio 1.000000), but it is a pass-through to apxUSD reserve risk with no priority over apxUSD holders and an asynchronous exit. legalEnforceability weak: the terms of service themselves document that holders have no claim on a legal entity or reserve estate. valuationCadence limited: issuer-published dashboard/attestation data corroborated by the named Wolf & Company reports and on-chain reads, but the reports do not reconcile current liabilities to the whole current reserve. maturityAndLiquidity weak: the apyUSD overview documents the liquidity constraint itself — redemptions are asynchronous with an approximately 20-day cooldown (or 3-day claim at a 3.5%-to-0.1% declining fee) — and no underlying tenor table exists. custody limited: wrapper assets sit measurably on-chain and the underlying securities are disclosed as third-party prime-broker custody, but no full custodian-continuity arrangement is established. recovery limited: the capitalization framework documents wind-down/pro-rata mechanics but no holder-priority waterfall or realized recovery performance. No strong-grade component: the D3 strong evidence class (named independent attestor + dated full reconciliation + enforceable filings, all pinned) is not met for any component.

weightedAverageMaturityDays.rationale: apyUSD wraps apxUSD, whose reserve Apyx values only as redemption value and total collateral value; the Accountable dashboard, transparency page, and attestation archive were searched and none publishes a weighted-average-maturity or remaining-tenor dataset, and the principal disclosed STRC/SATA holdings are perpetual. The disclosure should live on the Apyx transparency surface.

source.access: Fetched with browser origin/referer headers (Origin: https://accountable.apyx.fi); endpoint returned JSON. Query-string variants (dashboard?token=apyusd, dashboard?asset=apyusd) and paths /apyusd, /dashboard/apyusd, /tokens all returned HTTP 403 — no apyUSD-specific endpoint exists.

wrapperBackingRatio.note: totalAssets exceeds convertToAssets(totalSupply) by ~3.4e-8 apxUSD (rounding dust); backing is exact.

vaultShareOfApxUsdSupply.note: 179.50M of 327.07M apxUSD sits inside the apyUSD vault; the dashboard's reserve snapshot therefore already covers the vault's underlying.

weightedAverageMaturityDays.rationale: Neither the Accountable dashboard nor the Apyx transparency surface publishes a WAM or remaining-tenor dataset; the documented principal collateral (STRC, SATA) is perpetual preferred equity, and the wrapper holds apxUSD claims on that same reserve.

valuationCadenceDays.rationale: Monthly Wolf & Company attestation archive (March, April, May, June 2026 reports pinned) covers the underlying reserve; the wrapper exchange rate streams continuously on-chain but values apxUSD, not the reserve independently.
